220   // Operation selection and operand adjustment
221   // | \c op_q  | \c op_mod_q | Operation Adjustment
222   // |:--------:|:-----------:|---------------------
223   // | FMADD    | \c 0        | FMADD: none
224   // | FMADD    | \c 1        | FMSUB: Invert sign of operand C
225   // | FNMSUB   | \c 0        | FNMSUB: Invert sign of operand A
226   // | FNMSUB   | \c 1        | FNMADD: Invert sign of operands A and C
227   // | ADD      | \c 0        | ADD: Set operand A to +1.0
228   // | ADD      | \c 1        | SUB: Set operand A to +1.0, invert sign of operand C
229   // | MUL      | \c 0        | MUL: Set operand C to +0.0 or -0.0 depending on the rounding mode
230   // | *others* | \c -        | *invalid*
231   // \note \c op_mod_q always inverts the sign of the addend.
232   always_comb begin : op_select
233 
234     // Default assignments - packing-order-agnostic
235     operand_a = {fmt_sign[src_fmt_q][0], fmt_exponent[src_fmt_q][0], fmt_mantissa[src_fmt_q][0]};
236     operand_b = {fmt_sign[src_fmt_q][1], fmt_exponent[src_fmt_q][1], fmt_mantissa[src_fmt_q][1]};
237     operand_c = {fmt_sign[dst_fmt_q][2], fmt_exponent[dst_fmt_q][2], fmt_mantissa[dst_fmt_q][2]};
238     info_a    = info_q[src_fmt_q][0];
239     info_b    = info_q[src_fmt_q][1];
240     info_c    = info_q[dst_fmt_q][2];
241 
242     // op_mod_q inverts sign of operand C
243     operand_c.sign = operand_c.sign ^ inp_pipe_op_mod_q[NUM_INP_REGS];
244 
245     unique case (inp_pipe_op_q[NUM_INP_REGS])
246       fpnew_pkg::FMADD:  ; // do nothing
247       fpnew_pkg::FNMSUB: operand_a.sign = ~operand_a.sign; // invert sign of product
248       fpnew_pkg::ADD: begin // Set multiplicand to +1
249         operand_a = '{sign: 1'b0, exponent: fpnew_pkg::bias(src_fmt_q), mantissa: '0};
250         info_a    = '{is_normal: 1'b1, is_boxed: 1'b1, default: 1'b0}; //normal, boxed value.
251       end
252       fpnew_pkg::MUL: begin // Set addend to +0 or -0, depending whether the rounding mode is RDN
253         if (inp_pipe_rnd_mode_q[NUM_INP_REGS] == fpnew_pkg::RDN)
254           operand_c = '{sign: 1'b0, exponent: '0, mantissa: '0};
255         else
256           operand_c = '{sign: 1'b1, exponent: '0, mantissa: '0};
257         info_c    = '{is_zero: 1'b1, is_boxed: 1'b1, default: 1'b0}; //zero, boxed value.
258       end
